plain: By one person's whim, not by rule or reason

example.quote: This precedent may destroy the best man in the community, when he was arbitrarily attainted merely because he was not a Socrates.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 9, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
